health.label: Health
health.notes: Verified Player 1 health; 0-10 units = 0-100%. Two-way confirmed by controlled writes (controlled write 1 -> bar at 1 unit, human confirmed; a controlled write of 10 -> bar full, human confirmed).

ammo_low.label: Squirt gun ammo (low byte)
ammo_low.notes: LOW byte of the 16-bit little-endian squirt gun ammo counter at 0x1CCC. Compose with ammo_high (0x1CCD) as: (ammo_high << 8) | ammo_low. Verified writable by controlled writes (0x0137->'137', 0x0246->'246', 0x0050->'50' on the in-game HUD, all restored). In-game HUD renders the value in HEX digits; digits A-F render as glitch (digit font only has 0-9).

weapon_selected.label: Selected weapon (P1)
weapon_selected.notes: Canonical P1 weapon selector at 0x1CBC; writing switches the live weapon. Full ID map (verified, human-identified): 0=squirt gun, 1=fire extinguisher, 2=ray gun, 3=weed wacker, 4=holy cross, 5=canon, 6=soda cans, 7=tomatos (REAL weapon), 8=popsicle, 9=red peppers (UNRELEASED), 10=plates (released), 11=fork (released), 12=football (released), 13=flamethrower (UNRELEASED), 14-20 = not real weapons (slots occupied). Two-way causal confirmation on 0x1CBC: write 0 -> squirt gun, write 6 -> soda cans (both human confirmed); mirror 0x603A is write-inert (copy, rejected). Second screen exposes the 12 real released weapons (IDs 0-8, 10, 11, 12).

fire_ext_count.label: Fire extinguisher count
fire_ext_count.notes: Verified fire-extinguisher count at 0x1CCE (weapon ID 1). Pickup transition 0->0x99 observed; causal write 0x5A -> HUD '5' + glitch glyph (human confirmed); ownership test: write 0 -> weapon unselectable (human confirmed); restored to 0x99. HUD renders value in HEX.

soda_cans.label: Soda cans count
soda_cans.notes: Verified soda-cans count at 0x1CD8 (weapon ID 6). Correlation + causal write tests: wrote 0x32 -> HUD '32'; threw one -> 0x31 and HUD '31'; wrote 0x25 -> HUD '25' (all human confirmed). HUD renders value in HEX. Soda is owned iff this count > 0 (ownership model verified on soda + fire ext.). Separate from squirt gun ammo (0x1CCC).

neighbors_remaining.label: Neighbors remaining to rescue (P1)
neighbors_remaining.notes: Verified remaining-neighbor counter at 0x1D52, shown on the in-game HUD (decimal). Correlation 10->9->8->7 across four rescue rounds (131,072 -> 343 -> 7 -> 2 candidates); causal two-way write test: wrote 3 -> HUD 3, wrote 2 -> HUD 2 (both human confirmed), restored to 7. Impostor 0x071E rejected (tracks rescues but write-inert copy). Display-only; UI must not write this.

lives.label: Zeke spare lives (P1)
lives.notes: Verified Zeke spare-lives counter at 0x1D4C, as shown in the in-game HUD. Tracked 2->1->0 across two deaths (131,072 -> 605 decreased -> 50 exact-delta-1 -> 2 candidates); stayed 0 on save-state restore at 0 spare lives; next death at 0 triggered GAME OVER (human-confirmed). Impostor 0x13BF (216->215->214) rejected - jumped UP to 219 on restore, not a lives value. Display-only; UI must not write this.

medkit_count.label: Med-kit count (inventory)
medkit_count.notes: Verified med-kit count at 0x1D1A (inventory list item). Tracked 1->0->1->0 across use / save-reload cycles; causal write test: wrote 2 -> inventory list showed 2 med-kits (human confirmed), restored to 1. Impostor 0x12E rejected (write-inert copy). The second-screen MEDKIT button uses this slot to consume one med-kit (write count-1) together with a full heal (health 0x1CB8 <- 10); both slots are causally-verified writable. Item slot 0 of the u16 stride-2 item array.

pandora_box.label: Pandora's box count
pandora_box.notes: CONFIRMED 0x1D1C (LOW byte of item slot 1 in the u16 stride-2 item array). User verified in-game: writing this even (low-byte) slot grants Pandora's box. The array is u16 stride-2 starting at medkit 0x1D1A; the LOW byte (even address) is the grantable count, the HIGH byte (odd address) is write-inert for our purposes (writing it = +256, no new item). Second screen: READ shows live count badge; WRITE (tap PANDORA cell) grants one.

skeleton_key.label: Skeleton key count
skeleton_key.notes: CONFIRMED 0x1D1E (LOW byte of item slot 2). User verified in-game: writing grants the skull / skeleton key. u16 stride-2 item array (medkit 0x1D1A + n*2). READ = live count badge; WRITE (tap SKULL KEY cell) grants one.

clown_decoy.label: Clown decoy count
clown_decoy.notes: CONFIRMED 0x1D20 (LOW byte of item slot 3). User verified in-game: writing grants the clown decoy. u16 stride-2 item array. READ = live count badge; WRITE (tap CLOWNS cell) grants one.

This is a COUNT slot (picking up a key increments it). Rejected alternatives: 0x0103/0x0A03 (game-managed mirrors, overwritten by game), 0x10E7 (NPC-related, caused flicker). Second screen: READ = live count badge; WRITE (tap KEYS cell) grants one (increment n -> n+1).

neighbors_rescued.label: Neighbors rescued (P1)
neighbors_rescued.notes: Collected-neighbor counter at 0x1F9C; tracked 0->1->...->10 across all 11 WRAM snapshots in level 1. Monotonic within a level; reliable level-invariant rescue trigger. Display-only; UI must not write this.

last_rescued_x.label: Last rescued neighbor X (low)
last_rescued_x.notes: S11 rescue-latch record (0x1AB0): byte 8 = LOW byte of 16-bit LE world X of the most recently rescued neighbor (compose with last_rescued_x_hi: worldX = (hi << 8) | lo). VERIFIED 16-bit: at all 10 rescues (11 WRAM snapshots, ) the latch u16 exactly equals P1's 16-bit position (0x0130/0x0132), e.g. (366,579) not (110,67). Latches ONLY at rescue events. Display-only.

last_rescued_x_hi.label: Last rescued neighbor X (high)
last_rescued_x_hi.notes: S11 rescue-latch record (0x1AB0): byte 9 = HIGH byte of 16-bit LE world X (observed values 1-5, page disambiguator - without it all rescues cluster in the map's top-left 256px corner). Verified 10/10 against P1 position at rescue time. Display-only.

last_rescued_y.label: Last rescued neighbor Y (low)
last_rescued_y.notes: S11 rescue-latch record (0x1AB0): byte 12 = LOW byte of 16-bit LE world Y (compose with last_rescued_y_hi: worldY = (hi << 8) | lo). Verified 16-bit, 10/10 vs P1 position at rescue time. CAUTION: byte 15 (0x1ABF) is NOT a coordinate (stale 0x90-0x91) - do not use it as Y. Display-only.

last_rescued_y_hi.label: Last rescued neighbor Y (high)
last_rescued_y_hi.notes: S11 rescue-latch record (0x1AB0): byte 13 = HIGH byte of 16-bit LE world Y (observed values {0,1,2}). Verified 10/10 against P1 position at rescue time across all 11 snapshots. Display-only.

p1_x.label: Player 1 X position
p1_x.notes: Verified P1-X at 0x0130 (LOW byte of the 16-bit little-endian worldX; compose with p1_x_hi: worldX = (p1_x_hi << 8) | p1_x). Controlled write test: wrote 150 -> P1 teleported right (through wall); restored to 19 -> P1 returned to original spot. Mirrors 0x090E/0x0A1A. Display-only; UI must not write this.

p1_y.label: Player 1 Y position
p1_y.notes: Verified P1-Y at 0x0132 (LOW byte of the 16-bit little-endian worldY; compose with p1_y_hi: worldY = (p1_y_hi << 8) | p1_y). Controlled write test: wrote 30 -> P1 teleported UP; restored to 142 -> P1 moved DOWN back to original spot. Y grows downward. Display-only; UI must not write this.

p1_x_hi.label: Player 1 X position (high byte)
p1_x_hi.notes: HIGH byte of the 16-bit little-endian worldX at 0x0130/0x0131 (worldX = (p1_x_hi << 8) | p1_x). Verified: continuity test (straight left-walk, worldX 1336 -> 658 smooth while low byte wrapped) + multi-mirror 0x090F/0x0A1B/0x1AB9/0x1CB1 track exactly. This high byte is the page disambiguator: low byte alone cannot locate P1 (5*256 = 1280 px gap explained by the page structure). Display-only; UI must not write this.

p1_y_hi.label: Player 1 Y position (high byte)
p1_y_hi.notes: HIGH byte of the 16-bit little-endian worldY at 0x0132/0x0133 (worldY = (p1_y_hi << 8) | p1_y). Verified: high observed at {0, 2, 3} with low varying within each band (same page+offset structure as X). Display-only; UI must not write this.

ammo_high.label: Squirt gun ammo (high byte)
ammo_high.notes: HIGH byte of the 16-bit little-endian squirt gun ammo counter at 0x1CCC. Companion to ammo_low (0x1CCC). Part of the same verified writable u16 field.

current_level.label: Current level number (1-based)
current_level.notes: Verified level/stage counter at 0x1E7C (decimal 7804), u8, 1-based (new games start at 1). Tracked L2->L1->L2->L3 perfectly (01->02->03) while impostors 0x0B01/0x1B6D/0x6D55 diverged; causal cheat test: wrote 7 at the main menu -> new game started in Level 7 (human confirmed). The game reads it at level load. Second screen: READ drives minimap map selection (levels 1-2 ship maps); WRITE backs the on-screen DEBUG level-jump menu (buttons 1-10) — verified write path is main menu -> new game starts on that level.

ray_gun_count.label: Ray gun count (weapon ID 2)

OWNERSHIP MODEL (verified on soda + fire ext.): weapon owned iff count > 0; grant = write count > 0, remove = write 0 (becomes unselectable). Causal write test: wrote 5 -> HUD showed '5' for this weapon (human confirmed). HUD renders the value in HEX. Second screen: READ = live count badge + ownership gate; tap selects the weapon (writes weapon_selected).
